summary: Regression/visual test of the small RadarView.tsx positioning fix (ring/radiusFill/centerPulse explicit left/top + ZoomRing cy prop) via browser Preview (mobile viewport 375x667), using kauri@intro.demo demo account (token injected via localStorage, visibility toggled on via API since account defaulted to invisible). Radar tab loads with no crash/red-screen. Visually confirmed in browser: zoom distance rings, teal center pulse dot, and radius-fill soft circle are all correctly centered around the 'You' avatar marker at default zoom, after pinch/zoom-in via zoom-in control (x2), after tapping Recentre, and after changing radius via the radius sheet (500m -> 100m, fill circle shrank and stayed centered). No misalignment observed in any state.
verified_working: Radar tab (People mode) loads without crashing/errors after the fix
'me' marker, zoom rings, radiusFill, and centerPulse all render centered on the You avatar in browser Preview at default zoom
Zoom controls (radar-zoom-in) pinch-equivalent zoom in x2 keeps You marker + rings centered, no crash
Recentre button (radar-recentre) correctly recentres map back to default state
Radius chip -> Discovery radius sheet -> selecting 100m correctly resizes radiusFill circle and keeps it centered around You marker

No console/page errors introduced by the change (only pre-existing benign warnings: deprecated shadow* style props, deprecated pointerEvents prop, useNativeDriver web fallback warning -- all unrelated to this fix, seen previously too)
No React Native red screen errors observed in any tested state
action_items: None. Change appears correct and safe. Per the task note, true validation of the device-vs-browser rendering discrepancy this fix targets requires a real native device build -- not verifiable in browser Preview alone (browser already rendered correctly even before mentioning the fix scope, consistent with the agent-to-agent note).
critical_code_review_comments: Diff matches the 5 described edits exactly: styles.ring left:0/top:0, ZoomRing new cy prop (default CY) used in translateY calc, call site passes cy={cy}, radiusFill local radiusFillSize var reused for width/height/borderRadius/left/top, centerPulse inline left/top using CX/cy. No unrelated code (meAnchor, styles.me, styles.sweep, tierFor, gesture handlers) was touched, confirmed by inspection.

RingLabelA already took a cy prop before this change and is passed cy={cy} at the call site consistently with ZoomRing now, so ring circles and their distance labels should stay in sync at any custom height (Professional Radar with dynamic height prop) -- looks correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested regression checks passed in browser Preview

seed_data_creation: None (used existing demo account kauri@intro.demo; toggled visible=true via PUT /api/users/me/state, which is reversible/non-destructive demo state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This was a narrow visual/regression check on RadarView.tsx centering fix only, tested in browser Preview at 375x667. Confirmed no crash/regression across load, zoom in/out, recentre, and radius-change flows. Note: kauri@intro.demo demo account currently defaults to visible=false (invisible) on fresh login -- had to PUT /api/users/me/state {visible:true} via API before the You marker/rings render on Radar; future agents testing Radar visuals with this account should do the same.
rca_of_issue: N/A -- no bugs found; this was a fix verification session, not a bug investigation.
